item.title: Development of a magnetic interatomic potential for cubic antiferromagnets: The case of NiO
item.description:
📚 The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue
Interatomic potentials are essential for molecular dynamics simulations of magnetic materials, yet incorporating magnetic features into potentials for complex antiferromagnets remains challenging. Nickel oxide (NiO), a prototypical cubic antiferromagnet, exemplifies this difficulty. Here, we develop a methodology to integrate magnetic properties into interatomic potentials for cubic antiferromagnets by adding a magnetic Hamiltonian, which includes both the Heisenberg exchange and the Néel model. We apply this approach to NiO by constructing two potentials: one based on the Born model of ionic solids and another using a reference-free modified embedded atom method. The models are validated against density functional theory calculations and experimental data, showing excellent agreement in…

item.title: 有限非厄米链拓扑不变量收敛判据的机器学习预测
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Raghav Chaturvedi, Viktor Könye, Ewelina M. Hankiewicz
该研究关注一种基于矩阵极分解的拓扑不变量在有限非厄米链中的适用性，特别是非厄米趋肤效应下裁剪长度参数的选择问题。作者表明，该裁剪长度由物理衰减或局域化长度控制：在近邻和纯长程 Hatano–Nelson 型链中主要由单一局域化长度决定，而更一般长程跃迁模型中则受特征多项式的多通道根结构支配。随机森林回归能够捕捉有限尺寸和相边界附近修正，并可推广到未见过的哈密顿量和复基准能量。

item.title: 一种用于流体动力学的可解释卷积神经网络框架
item.description:
📚 Machine Learning: Science and Technology
👤 Kwame Agyei-Baah, Muhammad Rizwanur Rahman and Edward R Smith
该研究提出一种透明的卷积神经网络方法，用简单层流数据训练模型，使其作为算子精确匹配有限差分数值格式。模型仅通过少量可调权重学习前向欧拉三点模板，并体现一致性、对称性等物理原则。结果表明，该可解释模型不仅能连接传统数值理论与机器学习，还能在同类但未见过的多种流动条件下保持较强泛化能力。

item.title: Neuromorphic control of a simulated shape-memory-alloy-driven multi-legged robot using a spiking neural network
item.description:

👤 Daisuke Miki, Hiroto Takigasaki
We propose a spiking-neural-network (SNN)-based deep reinforcement learning (DRL) method for efficient autonomous locomotion control of a starfish-inspired multi-legged soft robot driven by shape memory alloy (SMA) actuators. Conventional soft-robot controllers have predominantly relied on open-loop, pre-designed periodic signals; however, manually designing and tuning coordinated motion in systems with many degrees of freedom and strong nonlinearities remains difficult. Here, we train an SNN controller for SMAs, whose nonlinear contractile responses resemble key aspects of biological muscle. item.title: Mass-Conserving Physics-Informed Neural Networks For The One-Dimensional Advection-Diffusion Equation
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Eszra Forenita Sigalingging, Liu Kin Men, Setianto Setianto, Ferry Faizal
arXiv:2607.06091v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The advection-diffusion equation is a fundamental model of transport phenomena in which mass conservation is an essential physical constraint. While classical schemes such as Crank-Nicolson preserve this property by construction, Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) enforce only the local residual of the governing PDE and are therefore not guaranteed to conserve global quantities such as mass over long integration horizons. In this work, we examine the extent of this limitation for the periodic one-dimensional advection-diffusion equation and evaluate a Mass-Penalty PINN that augments the standard PINN loss with a soft mass-conservation constraint. item.title: 范德华交替磁体Co₁/₄NbSe₂的拉曼光谱研究
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Dushyanthini Balasundaram, Bishal Thapa, Resham Regmi, Nirmal J. Ghimire, Igor I. Mazin, Patrick M. Vora
该研究结合偏振分辨拉曼光谱和密度泛函理论，考察Co插层及交替磁有序对层状化合物Co₁/₄NbSe₂晶格动力学的影响，并识别出六个拉曼活性声子。Co插层通过NbSe₂声子的区折叠显著重构振动谱，产生兼具区中心和区边界特征的杂化模，但对称性禁止Co原子参与拉曼活性模。跨越交替磁转变的变温拉曼实验未见不连续变化，但A₁g对称模中与面外Se位移相关的特征显示出自旋-声子耦合迹象。

item.title: 通过顶点偶极控制在人工自旋冰中工程化非线性磁振子散射
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Waleed I. Waseer, Peng Yan

item.title: 自旋霍尔电流的界面非共线过滤
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Dan-Yang Han, Zi-An Wang, Hong-Liang Chen, Bo Li, Wen-Jian Lu, Yu-Ping Sun, Liang Liu, Shu-Hui Zhang, Ding-Fu Shao
该文指出，在实际异质结构中器件相关的量并非完全体平均的自旋霍尔电流，而是穿过界面发射出的自旋流，因此应视为体相—界面混合响应。作者提出界面非共线过滤机制：低对称界面自旋轨道场与入射自旋霍尔电流的动量分辨自旋极化通常不共线，从而通过自旋依赖透射将隐藏的动量分辨自旋分量转化为可观测的非常规发射自旋流。基于最小模型和高对称狄拉克半金属模型的分析表明，常规自旋霍尔源也可在界面作用下发射显著的面外自旋极化。
